question.text: In the SEBI vs Shreepati Holdings & Finance case, how many alerts from BSE and NSE were closed without documented reasons?

answer.text: 83 alerts from BSE and 54 alerts from NSE (total 137 alerts)
No alerts were received during the inspection period

explanation.text: The Logic: During the inspection period, Shreepati received 83 alerts from BSE and 54 alerts from NSE. ALL of these were closed without assigning any reason, without maintaining any records, and without seeking additional information from clients. This total of 137 undocumented alert closures was a major violation. The Trap: The specific numbers (83 BSE + 54 NSE) demonstrate the scale of non-compliance. It was not a minor oversight but systematic failure to handle alerts properly.
